description: This file contains utility functions for beam tracing in a laser-based puzzle game, including direction reflection, laser stepping logic, and integration to trace laser beams across a grid with mirrors and blocks.

methods.name: reflectDirection(orientation, dir)
methods.description: Reflects a cardinal direction based on mirror orientation ('slash' or backslash).

methods.name: isInside(r, c, rows, cols)
methods.description: Checks if given grid coordinates are within grid bounds.

methods.name: buildTargetMaps(targets, rows, cols)
methods.description: Creates boolean maps for targets and lit targets for quick lookup during laser tracing.

methods.name: traceBeams(grid, lasers, rows, cols, targets, outSegments)
methods.description: Performs deterministic beam tracing for the provided grid, lasers, and targets; returns segments and which targets are lit.

methods.name: stepLaser(laser, grid, rows, cols, workTargetMap, workLitMap, out, maxSteps)
